experiment: Supplementary frozen presence gate before mask editing

policy.expansion: Repeat each part decision onto both source frames of its two-frame pair.
policy.initialization: Preserve every raw mask in frame 0 regardless of its pair decision.
policy.new_parameter_selection: none; no new threshold or alternative gate
policy.primary_test_status: supplementary postprocessing comparison; primary raw-mask and patch results remain unchanged
policy.probability_note: Score is maximum predicted patch coverage, not a calibrated probability.
policy.temporal_note: Two-frame readout; not claimed to be causal streaming.

calibration_evidence.denominator_note: Raw metrics count part-frames; patch metrics count unambiguous part-pairs. Their counts are not directly comparable.

policy.proposal_provenance: Proposed during the SAM2 test execution, before the controller viewed its held-out masks or scores; prompted by the calibration raw-mask versus patch-presence discrepancy.
policy.provenance_basis: Controller's contemporaneous task statement plus recorded calibration result hashes.

scoring: Dense masks on every frame after frame0; same ground truth for raw and gated outputs.
evaluation_status: Postprocessing comparison, not a replacement for primary results; no threshold tuning.

visible_without_eligible_gt_patch_in_pai.interpretation: Includes thin/sliver or moving visible parts without a qualifying 16x16 patch across the pair; not only small physical parts.
